# Architecture Decision Record (ADR) Template

> Store approved architecture decision records in `docs/decisions/ADR-XXXX-[title].md`.

---

# ADR-[NUMBER]: [TITLE]

## Status
[Proposed | Accepted | Superseded | Deprecated] (Date: [YYYY-MM-DD])

## Context
[Describe the context, technical problem, and forces at play. Reference relevant roadmap phases or source specification sections.]

## Decision
[State the exact architectural or mathematical decision made. Be concrete, normative, and unambiguous.]

## Rationale
[Explain why this decision was chosen over alternatives. Detail trade-offs, correctness implications, performance benefits, or mathematical necessity.]

## Relationship to Roadmap & Specification
[State whether this decision is derived verbatim from the original specification or represents an explicit user-approved architecture refinement or clarification.]

## Implementation Consequences
- **Positive Impacts**: [What becomes cleaner, safer, or more correct]
- **Constraints & Costs**: [What additional checks, types, or tests are required]
- **Affected Subsystems**: [List crates, modules, and passes impacted]

## Required Tests & Verification
[List mandatory tests, property suites, or negative fixtures required to enforce this decision.]
